Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: POC Trial Plan & Model Selection — Multilingual Support

Hi Sana / Tom —

Thanks again for the time on today's call. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan to validate model selection and multilingual behavior for your product search/chat feature. High-level asks from your side were: Spanish + French support, <1s median inference latency, and consistent relevance on merchandising queries.

Proposed 4-week POC (timeline we discussed):
- Week 0 (this week): finalise success criteria, data access + signed SOW.
- Week 1: integration + baseline runs (sample dataset from Acme).
- Week 2: evaluation across EN/ES/FR, iterate prompt/template.
- Week 3: performance tuning (quantization/batching) + fallback validation.
- Week 4: final report + go/no-go decision.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Relevance/accuracy: >= 85% (macro-averaged across EN/ES/FR) on labeled eval set.
- Latency: P95 <= 900ms, median < 600ms for 1k token context.
- Cost: token-cost/unit < target (we'll estimate once dataset is shared).
- Stability: no high variance between languages (std dev of relevance < 4%).

Model recommendation for the trial (primary + fallback):
- Primary: Llama-2-13B-chat (4-bit quantized) — good English + multilingual performance and strong community evals for instruction tasks.
- Fallback: Mistral-7B-instruct (quantized) — lighter footprint for burst/failover when capacity constrained.

Notes on configurations Nikhil will run: continuous batching, prefix KV caching for repeated product queries, and 4-bit quantization to hit latency/cost goals. We'll run both greedy and small-sample beam tests for ranking-sensitive queries.

Next steps that need alignment before we start:
1) Sana: confirm the eval dataset (sample 5k queries across EN/ES/FR) and share a Drive link or S3 access.
2) Acme legal: sign the attached SOW (see acme_poc_scope.xlsx).
3) Redwood: provide SOC2 summary + security checklist (attached).
4) Schedule: propose kickoff Mon 9 Mar if above items are OK.

I've attached a draft POC scope and our SOC2 summary. Happy to adjust success criteria — this is our suggested starting point.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
+1 415-555-0123

Thanks for the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from our side:

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.example.com>

Quick internal note / checklist for the SE run:
- We'll start with Llama-2-13B-chat quantized (4-bit) and measure accuracy vs Mistral-7B fallback.
- For Spanish/French, we'll run separate prompt templates and a small translation-augmentation test (translate-training approach) to measure fragility.
- Need: sanitized sample (5k) with language tag and expected relevance label (0/1/2). Ideally 500 labeled items per language for stable metrics.
- Perf testing: run 1k synthetic parallel requests to measure batching behavior and latency tail.

I'll prepare a short runbook and share by EOD tomorrow. Priyom, can you prepare the quantization kernel options we'll test?

-Nikhil
